scripts.clean-compiled: find src -maxdepth 1 -name Stage10-\*.s9 | sed 's/.s9$/.ts/' | xargs rm
scripts.clean: pnpm run clean-grammar; pnpm run clean-compiled
scripts.build: pnpm run build-grammar && pnpm run build-ts-files && pnpm run build-main
scripts.build-ts-files: cd src && for INPUT in Stage10-*.s9; do echo ${INPUT}; cat ${PWD}/${INPUT} | (cd ../../stage9 && npx tsx bin/t2tc.js -) > ${PWD}/${INPUT/s9/ts}; done
scripts.build-main: cd src && cat ${PWD}/Stage10.s9 | (cd ../../stage9 && npx tsx bin/t2tc.js -) > ${PWD}/Stage10.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest --typecheck run
